about.title: About OpenOrgOS
about.lead: The open-source community for a protocol — not an OS for internal organization management.
about.scopeBody: Trade between companies, university partnerships, NPO alliances, supply chains — any relationship requiring verifiable exchange across organizational boundaries.
about.visionQuote: OpenOrgOS aims to be the common protocol for organizations to communicate across boundaries.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: For community inquiries, use GitHub Issues. Tenant data and per-org operations are out of scope.

brand.title: OpenOrgOS Brand Guidelines
brand.body: Logo, colors, and acceptable use of OpenOrgOS marks. Community use only; commercial use requires prior consultation.

inclusion.title: Inclusion & Accessibility
inclusion.body: We welcome contributors from diverse backgrounds, jurisdictions, and expertise. We continuously improve accessible docs and UI.

careers.title: Careers
careers.body: Join as Maintainer, Reviewer, or Committee Member. Honorific contribution — not paid employment.
